summary: Eupraxia Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K furnishing an October 9, 2026 press release announcing that three abstracts on its Phase 1b/2 RESOLVE trial of EP-104GI for eosinophilic esophagitis were accepted for presentation at the ACG 2026 Annual Scientific Meeting (Nashville, October 9-14, 2026) and UEG Week 2026 (Barcelona, October 17-20, 2026). No transaction, securities issuance, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed. This is a routine clinical-conference announcement, not a special situation; no deal terms, ownership changes, or regulatory clocks arise. No risk-arb angle applies.
